# Florida Best Realty

> Independent South Florida real estate brokerage hiring agents. 90–95% commission including rentals, 24-hour payouts, free office space with 24/7 access, and direct support from two brokers.

This file expands on /llms.txt with the full recruiting-page content for AI agents.

Florida Best Realty is a licensed real estate brokerage in the State of Florida. Tagline: Best people. Best service. The site is a recruiting page for real estate sales agents and brokers in South Florida.

Office: 15807 Biscayne Blvd., Suite 213, North Miami Beach, FL 33160.

## Offer

Build a real estate career on your terms with two brokers who put agents first:

- 90–95% commission, including rentals
- Commission paid within 24 hours of closing
- Free professional office with 24/7 access in prime South Florida locations
- No desk, royalty, or transaction fees
- No monthly or annual fees
- Work from anywhere
- In-house title company
- Direct broker support after hours and on weekends

## Why join

Florida Best Realty was built by agents, for agents. Eugene Dison and Marat Zitsbank run a brokerage where agent success comes first: real support, fast payouts, and a professional home base, without corporate overhead.

- **90–95% commission:** Keep the vast majority of every deal, rentals included.
- **24-hour payouts:** Commission check is cut within 24 hours of closing, guaranteed.
- **Two brokers, real support:** Eugene and Marat are hands-on and know agents by name and deal.
- **After-hours and weekends:** Broker support is available when questions come up outside business hours.
- **Free professional office:** Space to meet clients at no cost to the agent.
- **24/7 office access:** Agents can use the office whenever it works for them and their clients.

## How joining works

1. **Apply** — Submit contact details through the callback form (under two minutes).
2. **Talk to a broker** — Eugene or Marat calls personally to discuss fit, goals, and next steps. No call centers. Response within one business day.
3. **Get set up** — Move into the free office, receive 24/7 access, and complete onboarding.
4. **Start closing** — List, sell, and keep 90–95% of every commission, paid within 24 hours.

## Coverage areas

Serving buyers and sellers across South Florida:

- **Miami-Dade County:** North Miami Beach to Homestead
- **Broward County:** Fort Lauderdale to Pompano Beach
- **Palm Beach County:** West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, and surrounding coastal communities
